phase-summary.outcome: Space Explorer now exposes authored level content as a visible browser surface instead of treating it as a hidden artifact behind import/export only.

file.description: Shows levels, runs, level kinds, structure counts, content counts, rules, and visual hints from the active bundle.
Builds a browser payload from the active level-content pack and renders the new panel.
Extends generated-output typing to include level-content and level-browser artifacts.

decision.summary: The first docs-site level-facing surface lives inside Space Explorer as a level-content panel rather than waiting for a larger separate editor shell.
decision.impact: Users can inspect authored levels immediately while broader project CRUD work remains deferred.

next.action: Keep later level/project CRUD work aligned with this panel instead of reintroducing hidden level-content state.
